effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can place this card face-up in one of your Spell & Trap Zones as a Continuous Trap.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand free-chain Quick Effect checks Main Phase and a free Spell & Trap Zone, moves the related handler face-up, and registers TYPE_TRAP+TYPE_CONTINUOUS with a standard reset.

official_references.matched_structure: Monster placed in Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap during the Main Phase.
MoveToField/type-change structure for face-up Continuous Trap monsters.

effects.printed_clause: During either player's turn, if this card is treated as a Continuous Trap: Add 1 Gravinity monster from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Quick Effect in the Spell & Trap Zone requires current Trap type, uses id+100, searches/confirms a Gravinity monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Continuous-Trap monster effect that searches an archetype card from Deck.

effects.printed_clause: During either player's turn, if this card is treated as a Continuous Trap: Move this card to another column.
effects.lua_implementation: A separate free-chain Quick Effect requires Trap type, main Spell & Trap sequence and another free Spell & Trap Zone; SelectDisableField chooses an empty own Spell & Trap Zone and Duel.MoveSequence moves the handler.

official_references.matched_structure: Selects another legal field zone and moves a card to a different column.
Quick Effect movement to another Main Monster Zone/column.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Gravinity Orbit once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The hand placement, search, and move options use distinct id/id+100/id+200 hard once-per-turn keys.

official_references.matched_structure: Distinct hard once-per-turn keys for placement and Continuous-Trap effects.

effects.printed_clause: Support implementation for using this card from the Spell & Trap Zone as Gravinity Synchro material.
effects.lua_implementation: The Spell & Trap Zone extra-material value now accepts only Gravinity Lapsix or Gravinity Galaxix as the destination Synchro Monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Official EFFECT_EXTRA_SYNCHRO_MATERIAL registration with a destination predicate.
Extra Synchro material value function limited by the summoned Synchro monster.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: those are the only destination monsters whose exact text grants use of Gravinity Monster Cards from the Spell & Trap Zone.

coverage_override.reason: Five records cover hand placement, search choice, column movement choice, per-effect HOPT, and destination-scoped extra-material support.
